master.11: Master 11, the Illuminator: heightened intuition, inspiration and sensitivity (a doubled 2). It can bring nervous tension and self-doubt. Taught as a call to inspire others while keeping routines grounded. Many people simply live it as a 2; use it as an extra dimension, not a prediction.
master.22: Master 22, the Master Builder: big practical vision, turning large ideas into real structures (a doubled 4). Pressure is high; the risk is burnout or fear of the scale. Break big goals into small systems.
master.33: Master 33, the Master Teacher: selfless service, healing and teaching with compassion (a doubled 6). It is rare in practice and many systems do not use it. Risk: carrying everyone else's burdens. Balance giving with self-care.
